description: This file defines the NullCache class in the Twig template engine, implementing a no-cache strategy by providing no-op method implementations for cache operations.

classes.name: NullCache
classes.description: Implements a no-cache strategy by providing stub methods that fulfill CacheInterface and RemovableCacheInterface requirements without performing any actual caching.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates an empty string as cache key; effectively disables key generation.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stub method for writing cache; does nothing.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Stub method for loading cache; does nothing.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns 0 as timestamp indicating the cache is always stale or empty.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Stub method for removing cache; does nothing.
